On Tue, May 14, 2025 at 09:25 Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samantha — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the impact.

I've completed an initial investigation. Below are findings and immediate actions taken (we'll follow up with RCA).

Findings:
- Burst window misconfiguration: HealthSync's dedicated policy had a burst_window_seconds value of 60s (should be 600s for your profile). This caused rapid depletion of burst credits under sustained-but-steady traffic, which in turn forced request gating (429s) once credits hit zero.
- Model routing change: A recent routing rule (rolled 02:14 UTC) mistakenly moved a subset of your requests to a lower-memory model variant which increased per-request CPU pressure and contributed to elevated tail latency.
- No infra/hardware failures observed — this is configuration + routing policy interaction.

Immediate actions performed (10:00 PDT):
- Rolled back the routing rule to the prior model variant for HealthSync traffic. Latency p95 dropped ~40% in the first 3 minutes.
- Increased your tenant's temporary burst window to 1200s and bumped burst credit cap by 30% to prevent re-triggering the gate while we stabilize.
- Disabled automated aggressive safety valve that was closing the window prematurely while credits were low (we will re-enable with corrected thresholds after testing).
- Opened Jira INF-7891 to track the RCA and follow-ups.

Attachments included: perf-dump-20250514.json (early diagnostic dump), console-metrics-snapshot.png (burst-usage chart).

Next steps / asks for Redwood ops:
- Confirm whether the routing rule change was part of a campaign or an automated rollout (owner and deploy id).
- Run a controlled canary for the corrected policy to validate stability for the next 24 hours.
- Engineering to produce a short post-mortem and proposed guardrail to prevent burst_window_seconds regressions (config validation + deploy-time checks).

Samantha — I'm keeping the temporary overrides in place; traffic should recover over the next few minutes. Please let us know if you still see errors or elevated latency. We will compile an exec-friendly status update and timeline.

— Monica Patel
Senior Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
